notes: AFDX characterization verifies the deterministic contract — BAG, jitter, policing, bounded latency — and the redundancy contract — dual-network delivery, Integrity Checking, first-valid-wins Redundancy Management. Because the network is statically configured offline, expected timing/bandwidth are deterministic and certifiable.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: BAG conformance
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the inter-frame interval on each VL is ≥ its BAG (1..128 ms) within the jitter bound.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Jitter bound
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm End-System output jitter ≤ the allocated bound (e.g. ≤ 500 µs).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Policing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Inject an over-rate VL and confirm the switch drops non-conformant frames.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Redundancy (A/B)
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm every frame appears on both networks and that first-valid-wins delivers one copy.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Sequence-Number / Integrity Checking
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Inject out-of-window Sequence Numbers and confirm per-network rejection.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Single-network-failure
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Disconnect one network and confirm transparent continued delivery.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Bounded end-to-end latency
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm worst-case VL latency stays within the offline budget.
